title: Ordered three block coordinates cover the full cube
statement: Let $d$ be a natural number and let $a,b,c\in\text{Fin}(3)$ be pairwise distinct. The union of the coordinate blocks indexed by $a$, $b$, and $c$ at level $1$ is all of $\text{Fin}(3^2)$.
